task_description: Add mobile navigation menu (hamburger menu) to the landing page. Currently, mobile users can only see a 'Başla' button and cannot access Features, Pricing, or Login pages from the header.

patterns.mobile_menu_state: Use useState hook to manage menu open/close state (isOpen boolean)
patterns.hamburger_icon: Three horizontal lines SVG icon (similar to dashboard header lines 67-69)
patterns.backdrop_overlay: Fixed overlay with bg-black/50 opacity, z-40, lg:hidden, onClick closes menu
patterns.slide_animation: Transform -translate-x-full to translate-x-0 with transition-transform duration-200
patterns.responsive_breakpoints: md: prefix for tablet+, lg: for desktop. Mobile menu shows below md breakpoint
patterns.client_component: Landing page Navigation component needs 'use client' directive for useState
patterns.close_button: X icon button in top-right of mobile menu to close
patterns.menu_links: Same links as desktop: Özellikler (/features), Fiyatlandırma (/pricing), Giriş Yap (/login), Ücretsiz Dene (/register)

existing_implementations.description: Dashboard already has a working mobile menu pattern with hamburger button, slide-out sidebar, and backdrop overlay

current_navigation.problem: No way for mobile users to access Features, Pricing, or Login pages from header
